text:
alyssa: Heads-up: starting rollout for release-2025.04.12 (api, runtime, console, router). Target quiet-window 01:30-03:30 UTC. Planned canary: api=3% -> 15% -> 40%, runtime pinned to v3.2.2, router staged flag on. Anyone seeing blockers?

deploy-bot: Ack. Dry-run passed. Planned sequence: api -> runtime -> router -> console. Will emit status on each wave. Command queued:
```
/deploy release-2025.04.12 --services api,runtime,router,console --canary 3,15,40 --pin runtime@v3.2.2 --quiet-window 01:30-03:30UTC --observe 10m
```

kevin: quick note 12h ago we saw a mismatch between router header rewrite and api v2 client path. At scale that caused 502 spikes. Suggest initial router at 1% and extended observe.

alyssa: ok dropping router canary to 1% and doubling observation. Will also enable router.verbose_header_logs=true for canary.

jared: console has a non-breaking telemetry change that inflates metrics by ~8% on ingestion. I'll gate it behind canary-only flag to avoid noise.

ops-bot: Baseline alerts: api_errors>=0.8% for 5m, p99>=500ms for 10m, kv_eviction_rate>=0.4% for 5m. Auto-escalation will page on sustained breach.

deploy-bot: Deploy wave 1: 3% (api,runtime,console,router). Pods creating...

maya: saw a handful of 504s from the api canary at +6m, investigating tracing. Not sure yet if client-side retries amplified the window.

kevin: router logs show header rewrite drops for certain UA strings (old bots). Count = 22 in 6m. That explains 504s upstream.

alyssa: holding ramp. Decision options: 1) rollback router to previous variant only, 2) pin router traffic to 0% and proceed with api/runtime/console, 3) pause full rollout and investigate 15m. Thoughts?

leo: prefer option 2. Keep api/runtime moving if safe. Router rollback is lower blast radius.

jared: agree. Also patch console canary flag so it doesn't emit telemetry to prod stream.

deploy-bot: Executing option 2 per @alyssa: pin router traffic to 0%, continue api/runtime/console at current canary. Commands run:
```
/deploy pin traffic --service router --percent 0 --reason "header-rewrite drops"
/deploy continue release-2025.04.12 --services api,runtime,console --canary 3,15 --observe 10m
```

ops-bot: Noted. Router pinned to 0%. Monitoring unchanged for api/runtime/console.

maya: tracing shows a path-level header missing on older clients causing route fallback to default which times out. We can add a tolerant header-parser in router v2.4.1, but that needs a small restart and smoke test. ETA ~45m.

kevin: I'll prepare a minimal patch and a rollback window. If patch isn't ready in 60m we should plan a full router rollback to previous stable (v2.3.9).

alyssa: add to release notes: "Router staged header-rewrite held due to legacy UA mapping; router pinned to 0% during investigation. API/runtime/console continued canary under reduced risk." Ops runbook updated with commands and rollback target.

deploy-bot: Canary for api/runtime/console progressed to 15% stable at +25m. Metrics: api_errors 0.2%, p99=180ms, kv_evictions 0.06%. console telemetry flag off for canary as requested.

jared: console looks clean at 15%. No telemetry surge.

ops-bot: Reminder: rollback commands in runbook:
```
/deploy rollback release-2025.04.12 --service router --to v2.3.9 --notes "failed header mapping"
/deploy rollback release-2025.04.12 --service runtime --to v3.2.1 --notes "fallback"
```

kevin: patch PR opened and flagged for expedited review. Will comment when image is pushed.

alyssa: thanks. Keeping thread live for router patch progress and any late alarms. Approvals for continuing non-router waves: alyssa, kevin, jared, maya.

deploy-bot: Thread set to monitoring. Will post completion or rollback events. :eyes:
